edits.text: PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff’s First Requests for Production subject to the specific objections and reservations stated below.

1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to each request to the extent it seeks information protected by the attorney-client privilege, the work-product doctrine, or any other applicable protection. Defendant’s objections are subject to, and do not waive, any applicable protection.

2. PRODUCTION. Subject to and without waiving the foregoing objections, Defendant will produce responsive, non-privileged documents in its possession, custody, or control, subject to any specific objections stated in response to an individual request.
3. PRIVILEGE LOG. To the extent required by applicable rules or agreement, Defendant will identify documents withheld on the basis of privilege or other protection in a privilege log.
4. RESERVATION. Defendant reserves the right to amend or supplement these responses as permitted by the applicable rules.

Please resend the requests. Documents will be produced as kept in the usual course of business or organized and labeled to correspond to the requests. We are willing to discuss a reasonable production sequence if needed.
